prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Learn How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Try these quick controls so you know how to interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for main control menu", "Double-click pet to open chat window", "Drag pet to move anywhere on screen"]
1: ["Quick setup takes under 2 minutes!"]
2: ["Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pet", "Creating or signing into your account ensures your pet customization and companion data are safely backed up."]
3: ["Meet Your Custom Companion", "Check how your pet will look on your screen before signing the official certificate."]
4: ["We will alert you when your pet is ready to leap onto your desktop!"]
5: ["Choose Your Pet Companion", "Select a category on the left and see unique traits and desktop interactions on the right."]
6: ["Choose Desktop Pet Location", "Select where your pet should first appear on your desktop.", "Pin to Screen Corner", "Free Roam Desktop"]
7: ["Adopt Your AI Desktop Companion & Unlock Starter Items", "Includes Bonus Custom Accessories"]
8: []
9: ["Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly summon or hide your desktop pet!"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions unlockable starter items and bonus accessories (free extras/gifts)
